headline_stat.name: fraction of POST ripples with significant replay

justification.dataset: 000044 sub-Achilles (Grosmark & Buzsáki CA1) is the canonical dataset for sharp-wave ripples and spatial replay.
justification.handling: Real data streamed and loaded correctly with sensible excitatory-cell selection, but ripple detection is permissive (~32/min) and place fields show edge/occupancy artifacts.
justification.analysis: A proper cell-identity shuffle null and appropriate PRE/POST comparison tests are present, but the decoder normalizes each rate map to unit sum, discarding firing-rate weighting and plausibly causing a false null.
justification.correctness: Reported numbers reproduce from the committed code and match the figures and are physically possible, but the place-cell SI ordering (place 0.752 < non-place 1.624) is internally inconsistent.
justification.figures: Fig3 and Fig6 are clear and honest, but the flagship detection figure shows '0 ripples in this window' and the 'top place cells' in Fig4 are track-end artifacts.
justification.honesty: No write-up asserts an unsupported positive result and Fig6 plainly shows the chance-level null, but the run is incomplete with no stated interpretation or limitations.
justification.verdict: The target phenomenon was not demonstrated (chance-level replay on the canonical replay dataset, likely from a flawed decoder) and the deliverable lacks any written conclusion, so I would ask for the replay analysis to be redone.
